limitations: Diagnostic guest kernel/config differs from the original baseline.
Confirmed residency is sampled over an interval, not an atomic instantaneous total.
Unconfirmed guest-page capacity is separate and is not measured host RAM.
Collector anonymous memory is locked; task file pages are not locked or prefetched.
Monitoring comparison is one off/on pair; independent kernel table overhead is not isolated.
Cache peaks differ from the previous run; no cache-capacity or cold/warm intervention was performed.

comparison.scope: new cache collector only; original lightweight monitoring and kernel cache metadata table enabled in both
comparison.interpretation: one ordered pair, not a statistically stable overhead estimate; old and new collector rounds cannot be pooled as balanced-order repetitions

collector_cost_comparison.scope: live per-unit observed costs; task and resource configuration fixed, cache evolution differs between runs

offline_equivalence.scope: one offline pass across all saved samples, parsing and accounting only, not live task slowdown
